mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) by at least 100k and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) by at least 0.1 percentage points over the past month signals a robust labor market that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100k and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, elevated housing starts (HOUST > 1200 thousand units) signal overvaluation and impending policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates strong supply-side activity that signals economic growth and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) falls below 500,000 million dollars, it signals weak consumer demand that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 500000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by at least 0.25 percentage points and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) by at least 0.1 percentage points over the past month signals a dovish monetary policy combined with a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS decreases by at least 0.25pp and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) with year-over-year growth above 2% indicates strong economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 YoY growth exceeds 2%.
